name: alisadikinma-ai-content-suite
description: AI content creation suite — image prompts, video prompts, scripts, and more

plugins.name: ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen
plugins.description: 3 skills + 1 agent + 13 reference docs for cinematic carousel image prompt production (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads). v2.21 adds Hard Rule #19: every slide depicting the creator MUST use the literal `creator` token in image_prompt body — backend pipelines regex-detect this to attach face_refs.

plugins.name: ai-video-promo-engine
plugins.description: 3 skills + 1 agent + 22 reference docs for end-to-end AI video promo production (brainstorm → script → image prompts → video prompts)

plugins.name: article-content-writer
plugins.description: 11 skills + 1 agent for AI-powered long-form article writing with Phase B tiered split pipeline (article-research Sonnet/Opus + article-strategy-outline Sonnet + article-write + article-score), 20 hard rules, 5 scoring gates (100-point combined), inline image prompts, 14 copywriting frameworks, AI humanization, per-type captions, auto creator-face injection, named-entity cover with Wikidata/Commons + lede + role-resolution

plugins.name: linkedin-post-writer
plugins.description: 4 skills + 1 agent for 2026-algorithm-optimized LinkedIn TEXT posts (1100-1300 chars). Single-shot orchestrator emits one OrchestratorOutput JSON per run with Depth Score validator (>=80 gate), 20-rule anti-slop rubric, 12 text hook formulas, link-in-comment discipline. Carousel format short-circuits to status=route_to_carousel_gen — backend dispatches the universal /carousel-gen engine (in ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen plugin) for slide + image-prompt authoring. v0.5.0 BREAKING: /linkedin-carousel skill DELETED (carousel design specs moved to /carousel-gen plugin). Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume.

plugins.name: social-short-form-writer
plugins.description: 2 skills for Instagram + TikTok caption authoring. /instagram-gen (4:5 photo carousel, 5-hashtag HARDCAP since Dec 2025, ≤125-char hook, NO link in caption — IG canonical) and /tiktok-gen (9:16 photo-mode, 5-8 hashtags, ≤100-char hook, first-100-char search-index gate, link-in-caption OK). English authoring (mirrors linkedin-post-writer v0.6.0 directive), Zod-validated discriminated-union output envelope, anti-AI-slop rubric. Pure content generation — emits one JSON envelope to stdout per run for backend ingestion. Pairs with linkedin-post-writer (long-form text + carousel routing) and ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen (universal slide image engine). Facebook Page caption authoring is intentionally OUT of scope — consuming backend reuses LinkedIn content (text format) or /instagram-gen output (carousel format).

plugins.name: pitch-deck-designer
plugins.description: 4 skills + 1 agent + 11 reference docs + cached NotebookLM research synthesis for visual-first investor / B2B pitch deck production. 4-stage pipeline: pitch-deck-brief (discovery) → pitch-deck-storyline (narrative arc design — HUMAN APPROVAL GATE) → pitch-deck-gen (visual production: per-slide image prompts via GeminiGen.AI / Nano Banana Pro, Seedance 2.0 video prompts, optional Remotion configs, speaker notes) → pitch-deck-validate (100-point quality gate: Visual Ratio + Narrative Arc + Ask Clarity + Investor Psychology + Anti-AI-Slop). Dual-mode adaptive: VC fundraise (Sequoia / Y Combinator / Kawasaki frameworks, AI-era 11-slide with 2026 moat-weight emphasis) vs B2B channel-partner (Indonesian mall / EO / food-court operator, ROI calculator, named-comparable case study, dated pilot offer). Hard rules: visual ratio >=70% per slide, headline <=10 words, source-tag every number, never close on Thank You, never AI-generate team faces, bottom-up TAM only. Indonesian-mode default (IDR primary, Bahasa headlines, named local comparables, BI/OJK/Kominfo compliance signals).
